# ADR-3072: A06: Documented vendor risk acceptance for OEM component 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

OEM components constrain remediation.

## Decision

Hardware programs MAY adopt a documented vendor risk acceptance for OEM component 12 (A06-12) when firmware cannot be patched in-house.

## Consequences

Acceptances include vendor SLAs.
